caption: who  where=(as whom)  what — the % in %sudo marks it as a group, not a user.

code:
jsmith    ALL=(root) /usr/bin/systemctl restart nginx
deployer  ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl restart nginx
caption: One command as root, nothing else — NOPASSWD is for automation accounts only.

code:
$ sudo visudo
>>> /etc/sudoers: syntax error near line 14 <<<
What now?
caption: A plain text editor would save the typo and could lock out sudo for everyone.
